concept.concept: Simple stack of books illustration with the phrase 'I Already Have Plans' underneath
concept.audience: Book lovers and introverts who prefer reading over socializing
concept.rationale: Introvert reader identity is a proven POD niche; this phrase is widely relatable and not currently dominated by one design, though the broader introvert shirt market is competitive.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Already Have Plans" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a centered stack of 5 books in varying heights, slightly tilted, with bold simple rectangular shapes and clean sharp edges. Books in solid colors: deep navy blue, burnt orange, forest green, cream white, and burgundy red. Single thick black outline around each book for definition. Plain cream background. Screen-print aesthetic with high contrast, solid color blocks, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Composition centered with generous margins, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif in black, 6 words maximum, positioned directly underneath the book stack with equal spacing, clean and legible.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I Already Have Plans' is a common, generic humorous expression widely used in everyday language to convey introversion or a preference for staying home. It does not appear to be a distinctive protected slogan associated with any specific brand, and the stack of books illustration is a generic clip-art style image with no character or IP associations. No known trademark conflicts identified.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'I ALREADY HAVE PLANS' correctly spelled and complete. The illustration shows a clean stack of four books in distinct colors (blue, orange/terracotta, green, dark red) with a retro illustration style. No IP concerns, no anatomy issues, clean background suitable for garment printing, and all text is legible and properly rendered.

listing.title: I Already Have Plans Book Lover Tee | Introvert Design
listing.description: Declare your reading priorities with this simple, witty tee featuring a stack of books and the phrase 'I Already Have Plans.' Perfect for introverts and book lovers who genuinely prefer a good story over social obligations. The clean illustration celebrates the quiet joy of reading and reflects your authentic social preferences. Whether you're a voracious reader, library regular, or someone who values cozy nights with books, this shirt speaks your truth. Great gift for bookworms, introverts, and anyone who needs a polite way to decline plans.
